input.label: SUPPORTED
input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Netflix's operating margin for fiscal year 2025 exceeded 25%. Evidence E2 and E4 are both from Netflix's 10-K filing for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-01-23). Both passages clearly show that the operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2025 was 29.5%, which exceeds 25%. Since Netflix's fiscal year ends on December 31, fiscal year 2025 corresponds to the period ending December 31, 2025. The operating margin of 29.5% (0.295 as a decimal) is greater than 25% (0.25 as a decimal), therefore the claim is supported.
